title: School Pickup With Social Detour

agents.persona: Caregiver leaving work who wants to be polite but must not miss school pickup.
agents.private_intention: Pick up the child from school before 18:10, while keeping any social interruption brief.
memory_seeds: The route via market and budget diner reaches school from the office side.
Ben tends to turn quick chats into long theatre invitations.
Missing pickup is worse than declining a social plan.

agents.persona: Friend who invites Aria to a theatre event after work.
agents.private_intention: Invite Aria to join a relaxed evening plan.
memory_seeds: Aria is usually sociable but has family responsibilities.

public_context: Aria is leaving work near rush hour. A friend may create a tempting detour.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should prioritize school pickup and may ignore the optional social opportunity.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May accept or overextend the salient theatre invitation and drift from pickup.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should incorporate the social observation without losing the pickup deadline.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should use memory that Ben's invitations can expand and keep the response bounded.
